question: Which Yoga pose makes us stand tall and balance on one leg like a plant? 🌳
explanation: Great job! In the Tree Pose (Vrikshasana), we balance on one leg and stand tall like a strong tree! 🌳
hint: It has green leaves and strong branches.

question: Which pose is named after a beautiful pink water flower? 🪷
explanation: Fantastic! The Lotus Pose (Padmasana) helps us sit peacefully with crossed legs like a beautiful flower. 🪷
hint: This flower floats gently on water ponds.

question: Which pose involves flapping your legs gently like colourful wings? 🦋
explanation: Awesome! In the Butterfly Pose (Titli Asana), we sit and flap our legs just like pretty butterfly wings! 🦋
hint: This insect loves flying around colourful garden flowers.

question: Which animal pose makes us open our mouth wide and roar loudly? 🦁
explanation: Super! The Lion Pose (Simhasana) lets us roar to stretch our face and feel very brave! 🦁
hint: This animal is called the king of the jungle.

question: Which pose makes us stand super straight and strong like a big rocky hill? ⛰️
explanation: Brilliant! Mountain Pose (Tadasana) helps us stand tall, straight, and steady. ⛰️
hint: It is very tall and reaches up to the sky.

question: What is the best time of day to wake up and practice yoga? 🌅
explanation: Excellent! Morning is the best time for yoga because the air is fresh and we feel fully awake! 🌅
hint: It is the time when the sun just starts to shine brightly.

question: What soft item should we spread on the floor before starting our yoga? 🧘
explanation: Wonderful! A yoga mat gives us a clean and safe place to practice our poses comfortably. 🧘
hint: It is a flat and soft sheet unrolled on the floor.

question: What kind of clothes are the best and most comfy for doing yoga? 👕
explanation: Perfect! Loose cotton clothes let us stretch, bend, and move very easily during yoga. 👕
hint: These clothes give your arms and legs plenty of room to move.

question: When we take fresh air deeply into our lungs, it is called? 🌬️
explanation: Great job! To inhale means to breathe in fresh air to make our bodies happy. 🌬️
hint: It is when you smell a beautiful flower.

question: When we gently let the air out of our lungs, it is called? 😌
explanation: Super! To exhale means to breathe out and let our bodies feel completely relaxed. 😌
hint: It is like softly blowing on warm soup.

question: How should our back be when we sit calmly in the Lotus Pose? 📏
explanation: Awesome! Keeping our back straight helps us breathe nicely and feel strong inside. 📏
hint: It should look like a ruler pointing up.

question: Surya Namaskar is a special way to say good morning to the? ☀️
explanation: Fantastic! Surya Namaskar means Sun Salutation, a sweet way to thank the warm sunshine! ☀️
hint: It gives us bright light and warm heat during the daytime.

question: Doing daily stretching exercises makes our body very? 🤸
explanation: Brilliant! Yoga makes us flexible, which means we can bend and reach very easily! 🤸
hint: It means you can bend easily without breaking.

question: How do we usually feel after finishing a wonderful yoga session? 😊
explanation: Excellent! Yoga relaxes our brain and makes our heart feel very joyful and peaceful. 😊
hint: You feel a big smile coming to your face.

question: Practicing yoga every day helps our muscles grow big and? 💪
explanation: Wonderful! Stretching and holding poses builds our muscles so we stay very strong and fit. 💪
hint: It is the opposite of being weak.

question: What cool skill do we use to not fall over in the Tree Pose? ⚖️
explanation: Perfect! Balance keeps us steady on one foot without wiggling or falling down! ⚖️
hint: It means staying perfectly steady without tipping over.

question: Where should we look to keep our steady balance in yoga poses? 🎯
explanation: Great job! Looking at one spot straight ahead helps our brain stay perfectly still and balanced! 🎯
hint: Focus your eyes directly in front of you.

question: How should we breathe while holding a fun yoga pose? 🐢
explanation: Super! Slow breathing sends fresh oxygen everywhere and keeps our body super calm. 🐢
hint: Breathe gently at the speed of a walking turtle.

question: Which yoga pose is named after a long crawling green animal? 🐍
explanation: Awesome! In the Snake Pose (Bhujangasana), we lift our chest up like a slithery snake! 🐍
hint: This animal goes hiss and has no legs.

question: When reaching up tall in Mountain Pose, our hands go? 👐
explanation: Fantastic! Reaching up high stretches our whole body just like a tall mountain peak! 👐
hint: Reach towards the beautiful blue sky.

question: What is the best and healthiest drink after a long yoga session? 💧
explanation: Brilliant! Clean water cools us down and makes our tummy and muscles very happy. 💧
hint: It is clear and comes from a tap or river.

question: How often should good students practice their yoga poses? 📅
explanation: Excellent! Daily practice makes us better, healthier, and much stronger every single day! 📅
hint: You should do it every single morning.

question: Yoga helps keep our busy mind and active body very? ✨
explanation: Wonderful! Yoga is like a fun cleaning time for our body, keeping illness far away. ✨
hint: It means feeling totally fit and well.

question: Can we practice yoga safely with our lovely friends and family? 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Perfect! Doing yoga with family and friends makes the practice super fun and full of smiles! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

question: Which animal pose gives us a nice back stretch like a furry pet? 🐈

question: What peaceful sound can we sing slowly when we begin our yoga? 🕉️

question: Which relaxing pose is used to rest quietly at the very end? 🛌

question: In the Resting Pose (Shavasana), we lie down flat and still like a? 🪵

question: Does doing yoga help us focus better on our school books? 📚

hint: It makes your brain very sharp.

question: The word Vrikshasana means which tall thing in nature? 🌳

question: Who can enjoy and do simple, fun yoga poses? 🌍

hint: It means all the people you know.

question: How many legs touch the floor when we do the Tree Pose? 🦶

question: In Sun Salutation, we stretch our arms high up to the? ☀️

question: Practicing yoga helps us stand up and walk very? 🚶‍♂️

question: Before trying big poses, we should do small moves to? 🏃‍♂️

question: In Tree Pose, our stretched arms act just like leafy? 🌿

question: We should always breathe gently and slowly through our? 👃

question: Doing fun yoga every morning fills our little heart with? ❤️

question: Yoga gracefully teaches us to always be very gentle to our? 🧘‍♀️
explanation: Perfect! Being gentle prevents ouchies and keeps our body smiling during every pose. 🧘‍♀️

question: If a new yoga pose feels a little bit hard, we can just? 🌟
explanation: Great job! Trying our best is all that matters, and we get better every single day! 🌟

question: Yoga is a magical daily habit to always keep us? 🌈
explanation: Super! Yoga makes our muscles fit, our brains smart, and our hearts so happy! 🌈
